**Completed:** the qualified generic cache/import change reused #62’s sealed DendroPy export with zero new generation or model calls and completed one independent native control workflow (two sides). The tracked contract passed: nop reward **0**, oracle reward **1**, F2P **0/1 → 1/1**, and all **1,145 P2P tests passed on both sides**. Subissue of #33.

**Quality limit:** four untracked test failures remain on both sides; the oracle command exits 1. This is a tracked positive pair, but **zero tasks qualify for our strict clean-command profile**. No tests, parser, reward, deadlines or resources were repaired. #64’s subtest gap remains separate. [Results](https://github.com/Open-Athena/biotasks/blob/6544dcd596eae5f6ba088fa8b178fd9d916dd602/experiments/65-sealed-case-safe-export/results.md), [final evidence](https://github.com/Open-Athena/biotasks/blob/6544dcd596eae5f6ba088fa8b178fd9d916dd602/experiments/65-sealed-case-safe-export/final-summary.json).

**Reproducibility:** 186 tests and both PR #63 CI checks pass; clean installed sealed-import and completed CLI replay are verified, with unchanged original raw/cache/grading assets. Both primary/cleanup HF anonymous readbacks and empty owned resources are verified; controller exited 0. Additional usage **0.362541 allocated CPUh, $0 model cost**. Keep child/epic and PR #63 open for review; no merge or release. Detailed logs and receipts are in comments.
